Inlet 6 - Newly Remodeled Beach Front Town Home Steps from 30A

In the heart of quaint Inlet Beach , this newly remodeled two-bedroom gulf front townhome is located on Inlet Beach, steps from 30A!

Besides its location and beautiful finishes, the large private balcony upstairs off the master bedroom is one of my favorite things about this property.

The open floor plan allows for Huge ocean views to be enjoyed throughout the home. There are no high rises, less traffic, quiet beaches, and so many things to do close by, from shopping and restaurants toactivities like biking, canoeing, walking trails, local farmer markets on 30A, snorkeling, and many more. A perfect getaway spot for the family.

Sleeps nine people with two kings (2nd Floor), two full built-in bunks, and a pullout queen sleeper sofa.

The First Floor is the kitchen, living room, and dining area with a Queen Sofa sleeper, a half bath, and a private ocean-front balcony.

On the second Floor, you have the master with a private balcony, double vanity in the master bath, with a walk-in shower. The second bedroom has a king bed and full-size bunks with a private bathroom.

This area is off the beaten path but also allows quick access to 30A and Panama City Beach. Great for long bike rides, walks, canoeing, snorkeling, and lots of shopping less than a mile away, with many restaurants and shops to enjoy in the 30A Avenue shopping complex. Please let us know if you have any questions!

Parking 2 cars allowed and overflow near your front door is steps away. No stairs to the front door.
